title: 4.1 Write `web/src/kit/data/schema-fields.test.ts` first (first assertion on `typeof schemaToFields`; the scenarios of "SchemaForm renders the supported JSON Schema subset as typed fields" and "Anything outside the subset is a visible unsupported error"), then implement `MAX_SCHEMA_PROPERTIES` (100), `SchemaField`, `SchemaFields` and `schemaToFields` in `web/src/kit/data/schema-fields.ts`; it never throws and never drops a property. Keys come from `Object.keys` and `Object.hasOwn`; a plain object has prototype `Object.prototype` or `null`. Kinds and keywords: `string` (`minLength maxLength pattern`), `integer`/`number` (`minimum maximum`), `boolean`, `enum` (`enum` of texts, `type` absent or `"string"`), `string-list` (`type: "array"`, `items: { type: "string", minLength?, maxLength?, pattern? }`); all accept `type`, `title`, `description`. A property is checked in this order, the first fault making it `{ kind: "unsupported", reason, error: "Unsupported: " + reason }` (reasons as in the scenarios, plus those below; schema text quoted in a reason, `<type>` or `<key>`, is cut to 40 `length` units, 39 plus `…`, control characters as spaces; `error` is cut to 500 `length` units): not a plain object; name fails `isFieldName` (`name` is the name cleaned of control characters, cut to 64, and `label` is that name, or `Field <i+1>` when blank, `i` the index in `fields`); `enum` with a `type` other than `"string"` (`enum is supported for text values only`); `type` missing, not a text (`type must be a single name`) or not one of `string number integer boolean array` (`type "<type>" is not supported`); the first key outside the kind's keywords; then values: `title` (untrimmed text of 1 to 80 characters, else `title must be text of 1 to 80 characters`), `description` (`description must be text`), `minLength`/`maxLength` (`<key> must be an integer from 0 to 10000`), `pattern` (text of at most 200 characters that `new RegExp(pattern, "u")` accepts), `minimum`/`maximum` (`<key> must be a finite number`), `enum` (1 to 100 distinct texts of 1 to 200 characters), `items` (a plain object with `type: "string"`; other keys give `keyword "<key>" is not supported in items`; values as above, messages prefixed `items `). Label: `title` trimmed, else the name with `_` as a space and a space before an upper-case letter that follows a lower-case letter or digit, lower-cased, first letter capital; a blank `title` counts as absent; the label is cut to 80 `length` units (79 plus `…`). Hint: the trimmed description, `null` if blank, cut to 300 `length` units (299 plus `…`). `required` names without a property, de-duplicated and only the first 20, append `unsupported` fields (named as above). A field that is not `unsupported` passes `isFieldName`, so `fieldModel` and `formModel` accept it. Root problems in this order (texts as in the scenarios): not a plain object, `type` not `"object"` (both without fields); each key outside `$schema type title description properties required additionalProperties`; `properties` not a plain object (`properties must be an object`); `required` not a list of texts (`required must be a list of property names`); `additionalProperties` not a boolean; more than 100 properties (without fields). Other problems still return the fields, implementing requirements "SchemaForm renders the supported JSON Schema subset as typed fields" and "Anything outside the subset is a visible unsupported error"
